# SmartLifeUtils

> SmartLifeUtils is a one-person studio in Slovenia that makes games and apps for iPhone, iPad and Android. It has three apps: Wave Rider (a boat stunt racing game), Ink Bounce (a one-thumb arcade game) and Budget Buddy (an expense tracker and budget planner). All three are free to download. Contact: smartlife.utilities@gmail.com.

Each app has its own website on this domain. The facts on those pages were checked against the apps' own source projects, so prefer them over older store listings.

## Wave Rider: Boat Stunt Racing

A physics boat game for iPhone, iPad and Android where every wave is a ramp: jump, flip and land a boat on a sea that never stops moving. Two buttons (throttle and brake) steer the boat on the water and tip it in the air. Boats: Motor Dinghy (free), Speedboat, Jet Ski and Rescue RIB. Seas: Calm Lake, Nile, Loch Ness, Pacific and Caribbean, each with its own waves, one rule and local animals. Coins from runs and stunts unlock boats and seas and pay for upgrades (engine, hull, propeller, trim and fuel). Daily missions and a login streak. Plays offline with no account. Free with ads; optional coin packs and a one-time Remove Ads purchase.

- [Wave Rider home](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/waverider/): trailer, screenshots, tricks, boats, seas and upgrades
- [Boats](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/waverider/boats.html): each boat, where it does best and its stats
- [Seas](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/waverider/seas.html): each sea, its rule, its locals and which boat fits it
- [Garage](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/waverider/garage.html): how upgrades change a boat
- [Support and FAQ](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/waverider/support.html): offline play, ads and purchases, lost progress, contact
- [Press kit](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/waverider/press.html): fact sheet, screenshots and videos

## Ink Bounce

A free one-thumb arcade game for iPhone, iPad and Android, released in August 2026. The orb is already moving: you draw the line it bounces off before the ink runs out. 100 levels in 5 worlds (Ice Valley, Ancient Grove, Frost Shrine, Ashen Rift and Sun Temple), a boss at the end of each world, and Endless, one corridor that keeps getting faster, with Fever, daily twists, challenges and leaderboards. Gear, boosts, 54 orb skins and 104 badges. Plays offline in landscape; needs iOS 15 or Android 7.1 or later. Free with ads; a one-time Remove Ads purchase and optional coin and gem packs.

- [Ink Bounce home](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/inkbounce/): trailer, modes, how to play, worlds
- [Worlds](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/inkbounce/worlds): the five worlds, their hazards and bosses, how stars are won
- [Endless](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/inkbounce/endless): the endless mode, Fever, challenges and leaderboards
- [Gear and skins](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/inkbounce/gear): gear, boosts, orb skins and badges
- [Support and FAQ](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/inkbounce/support): devices, offline play, purchases, lost progress, contact
- [Press kit](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/inkbounce/press): fact sheet, trailer, screenshots and world art

## Budget Buddy

An expense tracker and budget planner for iPhone and Android, first released in February 2026, in 26 languages with 121 currencies. It needs no account and no bank login and works offline. Log spending and income in a few taps, see how much is left to spend today, give categories a weekly, monthly or yearly budget, get a daily summary and a weekly check-in, see recurring payments and subscription price rises, keep receipt photos and warranty dates, plan savings goals month by month, and look at the balance up to 24 months ahead with Plan Ahead. There is no server: entries stay on the phone, with a PIN, Face ID or fingerprint lock, weekly backups and export. The free version shows Google AdMob ads, and Google receives device and ad data to serve them; a currency rate lookup sends only two currency codes. No cloud sync. Premium is an optional yearly subscription (9.99 USD on the App Store, 10.99 USD on Google Play in the US) that removes ads and adds bill scanning, repeating payments, smart insights and unlimited accounts, categories and budgets.

- [Budget Buddy home](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/): the app's overview, trailer, screens and common questions
- [Tracking](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/tracking.html): logging, bill scanning, receipts, repeating payments, categories and accounts
- [Budgets and savings goals](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/budgets.html): budgets, pace and forecast, track record, savings goals
- [Insights](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/insights.html): charts, net flow, Plan Ahead and monthly recaps
- [Your data](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/data.html): on-device storage, lock, backups, export and privacy
- [Free and Premium](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/premium.html): what is free, what Premium adds and what it costs
- [Support and FAQ](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/support.html): new phone, backups, Premium, imports, contact
- [Press kit](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/press.html): fact sheet, screenshots and trailer
- [Privacy policy](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/privacy.html): what stays on the phone, ads, purchases and your rights
- [Terms of use](https://smartlifeutils.github.io/budgetbuddy/terms.html): licence, Premium subscription terms and liability
